observed_sample: User personally bought one test bundle. Guaranteed V was described as nice. The advertised holo/reverse-holo extras in the received sample were Trainer cards rather than Pokémon.
quality_read: V/hero hit strong; shiny-support composition weaker for child-facing appeal because the holo/RH extras were Trainers.
notes: Use this as a firsthand product-quality sample, not proof that every bundle from the seller has the same composition. It strengthens our differentiation if our stated holo/RH quota is Pokémon rather than Trainer holo/RH.
